page: Amazon Web Services m7i.8xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine running on the AWS Nitro System hypervisor. It is powered by an x86_64 Intel Xeon 8488C processor running at a base clock speed of 3.2 GHz, featuring 16 physical cores configured with multithreading to provide 32 dedicated vCPUs. The processor includes 105 MB of L3 cache, 2 MB of L2 cache per core, and hardware instruction support for AVX-512, AMX (tile and int8), and hardware cryptography (AES, VAES, SHA-NI). System memory totals 128.0 GB of DDR5 RAM operating at 5000 MT/s, maintaining a standard 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio of 4.0 GB per vCPU. The instance does not include a GPU, lacks bundled local storage, and provides a baseline network bandwidth of 12 Gbps.

Benchmark results demonstrate strong general computing capabilities across standardized suites. Geekbench evaluations return scores of 2048.0 for single-core and 16303.0 for multi-core, with high performance in image processing (14843.0) and text processing (2488.0). Compression throughput is competitive, with single-threaded gzip reaching 32.91 GB/sec. Memory subsystem bandwidth registers 159.52 GB/sec for large read operations and 82.3 GB/sec for large write operations. In application-focused metrics, the instance achieves 46.4 GB/sec in static web serving throughput and maintains 37.27 million operations per second in Redis SET operations. Supported by AMX and AVX-512 VNNI instruction sets, text generation throughput on small (135M) language models reaches 413.98 tokens per second, placing it in the top tier.

With its balanced allocation of 32 vCPUs and 128 GB of DDR5 memory, m7i.8xlarge delivers balanced resource density for production systems. Because it lacks integrated local NVMe storage, persistent data access requires networked storage solutions such as Amazon EBS. The hardware profile is aligned with enterprise general-purpose workloads, including high-concurrency web serving, application middleware, distributed caching, microservice orchestration, and CPU-based lightweight machine learning inference.
description: Amazon Web Services m7i.8xlarge is a general-purpose cloud instance built on the AWS Nitro hypervisor and powered by a 32-vCPU (16 physical cores) Intel Xeon 8488C processor clocked at 3.2 GHz. It features 128.0 GB of high-speed DDR5 memory (4.0 GB per core), 105 MB of L3 cache, and dedicated hardware acceleration instructions including AVX-512 and AMX. The instance includes no bundled local storage and operates without discrete GPUs, supported by a 12 Gbps baseline network interface. In benchmark evaluations, it demonstrates strong performance in Geekbench single-core (2048.0) and multi-core (16303.0) tests, gzip compression (32.91 GB/sec), and static web serving (46.4 GB/sec), alongside top-tier text generation on small LLM models (413.98 tokens/sec). The m7i.8xlarge is well configured for enterprise web services, caching tiers, container orchestration, and general-purpose backend applications requiring steady multi-threaded CPU and memory throughput.
